subject: paediatrics
title: Trace Element Deficiencies, Scurvy and Infantile Beriberi

steps.tx: Micronutrients and trace elements serve as mandatory prosthetic groups for vital metabolic pathways. Maternal and environmental **iodine deficiency disorders** represent the foremost preventable cause of irreversible intellectual disability worldwide. Severe gestational iodine deficiency deprives the developing fetal brain of thyroxine during critical neurogenesis windows, resulting in endemic cretinism characterized by severe mental deficiency, deaf-mutism, squint, and spastic diplegia.
steps.say: Iodine deficiency is the leading preventable cause of mental disability globally. Gestational deprivation prevents adequate fetal brain thyroid hormone synthesis, causing endemic neurological cretinism.

vis.caption: Comparative features of endemic cretinism, acrodermatitis enteropathica, and infantile scurvy. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: Defective intestinal zinc absorption precipitates a characteristic mucocutaneous and diarrhoeal triad. The autosomal recessive disorder **acrodermatitis enteropathica** results from loss-of-function mutations in the SLC39A4 gene encoding the enterocyte ZIP4 zinc transporter. Symptoms erupt acutely when an infant is weaned from zinc-rich breast milk to formula, featuring sharply demarcated vesiculobullous and pustular plaques around body orifices and acral extremities, accompanied by intractable diarrhoea and alopecia.
steps.say: Acrodermatitis enteropathica stems from an inherited zinc transporter defect. Weaning from breast milk precipitates periorificial pustular dermatitis, intractable diarrhoea, and alopecia, rapidly cured with oral zinc.

steps.tx: Defective collagen cross-linking induces widespread vascular fragility and subperiosteal haemorrhages. Nutritional **infantile scurvy** arises from prolonged dietary lack of ascorbic acid (vitamin C) in infants fed boiled cow milk without fruit juices. Because ascorbic acid acts as an essential electron donor for prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases, unhydroxylated procollagen chains cannot form stable triple helices, causing profound microvascular fragility and bone pain.
steps.say: Infantile scurvy stems from vitamin C deficiency, impairing collagen cross-linking. Infants present with intense bone pain, bleeding gums, and pseudoparalysis, holding legs in a frog-leg posture.

steps.tx: Subperiosteal bleeding causes excruciating bone tenderness and apparent limb immobility. The scorbutic infant adopts a characteristic **pithed frog posture**, keeping both lower extremities partially flexed, abducted, and externally rotated while crying bitterly whenever touched or moved. Radiography of long bones reveals the dense white line of Fraenkel, Pelkan lateral spurs, and the adjacent Truemmerfeld zone of rarefaction.
steps.say: Extreme subperiosteal pain forces scorbutic infants into a flexed, abducted pithed-frog posture. Skeletal radiographs demonstrate Fraenkel white line, Pelkan spurs, and scorbutic rarefaction zones.

left.title: Scurvy Radiographic Markers
points: White line of Fraenkel (dense provisional calcification)
Truemmerfeld radiolucent zone below white line
Wimberger sign around epiphyseal ossification center

right.title: Clinical Response to Ascorbic Acid
points: Bone pain resolves within 24 to 48 hours
Oral dose: 100 to 300 mg daily ascorbic acid

steps.tx: Impaired pyruvate dehydrogenase and transketolase function drives fulminant infantile neuro-cardiovascular collapse. Thiamine deficiency precipitates acute **infantile beriberi** in breastfed infants aged one to four months whose mothers subsist on polished white rice. The acute cardiac form causes sudden congestive heart failure, extreme tachycardia, cardiomegaly, hepatomegaly, and a characteristic voiceless or aphonic cry secondary to recurrent laryngeal nerve neuropathy.
steps.say: Infantile cardiac beriberi strikes infants of thiamine-deficient mothers. Presenting with sudden heart failure, aphonia, and tachycardia, it responds dramatically to intravenous thiamine within hours.

steps.tx: Defective methionine synthase and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase activity compromises neurodevelopment and hematopoiesis. Severe **infantile vitamin B12 deficiency** manifests in infants exclusively breastfed by strict vegetarian or pernicious anaemia mothers, presenting between four and eight months of age. Clinical hallmarks include macrocytic megaloblastic anaemia, marked apathy, developmental regression, hypotonia, involuntary tremors, and prominent hyperpigmentation over the dorsal phalangeal knuckles.
steps.say: Vitamin B12 deficiency in infants of vegan mothers produces megaloblastic anaemia, developmental regression, hypotonia, and dark pigmentation over knuckle joints. Intramuscular cobalamin restores progress.

steps.tx: Universal public health measures prevent widespread microcytic hypochromic anaemia and developmental compromise. National guidelines enforce **prophylactic iron supplementation** in healthy term infants starting at four to six months of age at a dose of one milligram per kilogram daily of elemental iron. Premature and low-birth-weight neonates, who possess diminished congenital hepatic iron stores, require two to three milligrams per kilogram daily starting earlier at six to eight weeks of age.
steps.say: Term infants should receive one milligram per kilogram daily of elemental iron from four to six months. Preterm babies require higher doses of two to three milligrams starting at six to eight weeks.

rows: Give 2 to 3 months beyond normal Hb

steps.tx: Coordinated micronutrient programmes integrate trace element fortification into routine primary health care. Universal salt iodization maintaining at least fifteen parts per million of iodine at the household level ensures maternal thyroid adequacy and prevents fetal cretinism. Combining targeted prophylactic iron, vitamin A drops, and therapeutic oral **zinc during diarrhoea** (twenty milligrams daily for fourteen days) significantly decreases child morbidity across vulnerable communities.
steps.say: Salt iodization prevents endemic cretinism across populations. Giving oral zinc for fourteen days during acute childhood diarrhoea accelerates mucosal repair and prevents future episodes.

left.title: Universal Salt Iodization
points: Mandates >=15 ppm iodine in domestic salt
Prevents maternal goitre and fetal abortion

right.title: Therapeutic Zinc in Diarrhoea
points: 10 mg daily under 6 months; 20 mg daily older
Accelerates enterocyte regeneration and reduces relapse
